title: Characters and Meet & Greets
theme: Rare characters, meet spots, and character dining
intro: [excited] Hugs, autographs and waffles! Tonight is all about meeting Disney characters and eating with them. [laughs] Get those autograph books ready!

art.prompt: A whimsical outdoor character meet spot with a velvet rope line, a decorated photo backdrop, an open autograph book and a breakfast table, golden morning light Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

categories.title: Rare Character Sightings
categories.intro: [gasps] Autograph books ready! These characters don't come out very often, so spotting them is like finding a hidden Mickey. [excited] Let's go hunting!

art.prompt: An open autograph book with a fancy pen on a park bench, glowing sparkles drifting up toward a castle at golden hour, no writing on the pages Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Tokyo DisneySea made this sailor-suited teddy bear, Mickey's gift from Minnie, a superstar starting in 2005.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Duffy! In Japan, he's an absolute rock star. Fans carry him everywhere.

clues.clue: This little purple dragon from EPCOT's Journey Into Imagination sometimes pops up to meet his fans.
clues.reveal: [laughs] The correct answer is Figment! One little spark of imagination is all it takes.

clues.clue: This citrus-headed bird debuted at Magic Kingdom's Sunshine Tree Terrace in 1971 and became a cult favorite.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is the Orange Bird! Created to promote Florida oranges, and now fans line up for him.

clues.clue: This pink fox with a magnifying glass joined Duffy and Friends after first appearing at Shanghai Disneyland.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is LinaBell! She solves mysteries and breaks the internet. Very busy fox.

clues.clue: This pistol-packing rooster from The Three Caballeros is one of the rarest characters to meet in the parks.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Panchito Pistoles! The third caballero. Ay, ay, ay!

categories.title: Breakfast with Friends
categories.intro: [excited] Who's hungry? I'll show you a photo of a place where you can eat with Disney characters. You tell me the name of the place.

art.prompt: A sunny breakfast table set with Mickey-shaped waffles, fruit, juice and a castle visible through a big arched window, pastel morning light Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Princesses host meals inside this Magic Kingdom landmark's restaurant. Name the restaurant.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Cinderella's Royal Table! You eat inside the castle. Up the stairs, past the mosaics, very fancy.

clues.clue: Pooh and his pals host meals at this Victorian glass restaurant on Main Street. Name it.
clues.reveal: [chuckles] The correct answer is The Crystal Palace! Tigger will bounce right up to your table.

clues.clue: Chef Mickey's is inside this resort, where the monorail runs through the building. Name the resort.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Disney's Contemporary Resort! Eat with Mickey while a monorail flies by. Peak Disney.

clues.clue: This building hosts 'Ohana and a Lilo and Stitch breakfast. Name the resort it's in.
clues.reveal: [laughs] The correct answer is Disney's Polynesian Village Resort! The Great Ceremonial House. Aloha to you too.

clues.clue: This EPCOT restaurant hosts a princess meal and takes its name from a fortress in Oslo. Name it.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Akershus Royal Banquet Hall! A princess meal in Norway. Very regal.

source.author: HarshLight from San Jose, CA, USA

categories.title: Where to Find Them
categories.intro: [whispers] Insider tip time. I'll describe a meet spot, and you tell me where it is. [chuckles] No maps allowed.

art.prompt: A treasure map style illustration of a whimsical theme park with dotted paths, small stars marking meeting spots, a compass rose, no text Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: At Magic Kingdom, Mickey meets guests in a theater named after this square at the start of Main Street, U.S.A.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Town Square! Mickey even does magic there. Abracadabra.

clues.clue: Minnie, Daisy, Donald and Goofy have met guests in Pete's Silly Sideshow, in this circus-themed area of Fantasyland.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Storybook Circus! [laughs] Step right up, folks.

clues.clue: At Disneyland, you can visit Mickey's house in this colorful land that opened in 1993.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Mickey's Toontown! It's a whole cartoon town. Toot toot.

clues.clue: Opened in 2016, Adventurers Outpost lets guests meet Mickey and Minnie in safari gear in this park.
clues.reveal: [laughs] The correct answer is Disney's Animal Kingdom! Mickey in a safari hat. It's adorable.

clues.clue: Opened in 2016 in EPCOT's Norway pavilion, this cottage is where guests meet Anna and Elsa.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is Royal Sommerhus! The royal summer house. Bring your Frozen gloves.

categories.title: Dine Like a Character
categories.intro: Grab a fork! Every answer here is a famous food from a Disney or Pixar film. [laughs] Don't eat the screen.

art.prompt: A long banquet table filled with sugary beignets, a plate of spaghetti and meatballs, colorful vegetables in a spiral, and a covered silver dish, candle light Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Tiana is famous for these powdered-sugar pastries in The Princess and the Frog.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is beignets! Tiana's beignets. Watch out for the powdered sugar.

clues.clue: Gaston brags that as a boy he ate four dozen of these every morning. Now, he eats five dozen.
clues.reveal: [laughs] The correct answer is eggs! Five dozen. That's sixty eggs. Gaston, buddy, see a doctor.

clues.clue: In Be Our Guest, Lumiere tells Belle to try this, saying it's delicious.
clues.reveal: [chuckles] The correct answer is the grey stuff! Don't believe me? Ask the dishes.

clues.clue: Lady and the Tramp share spaghetti at Tony's restaurant. This chef helps serve it.
clues.reveal: [sighs] The correct answer is Joe! He sings Bella Notte while they share a noodle. It's the most romantic noodle ever.

clues.clue: Remy's famous ratatouille is actually a fancy version of the dish called this.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is confit byaldi! Thinly sliced veggies in a pretty spiral. Anton Ego cried. I would too.

categories.title: Seasonal Sightings
categories.intro: [laughs] Some characters only show up during the holidays! You tell me who or where. [whispers] They might be watching you right now.

art.prompt: A park street half decorated for Halloween with jack-o'-lanterns and half for Christmas with twinkling lights and snow, a giant moon overhead Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: In Magic Kingdom's Christmas parade, this jolly man in red rides on the last float.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Santa Claus! He saves the best for last. Ho ho ho!

clues.clue: The Pumpkin King from The Nightmare Before Christmas appears with Sally during Disney Halloween parties.
clues.reveal: [laughs] The correct answer is Jack Skellington! What's this? What's this? A Halloween party!

clues.clue: The Hocus Pocus Villain Spelltacular stage show at Magic Kingdom starred these three witches.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is the Sanderson Sisters! Amok, amok, amok!

clues.clue: Before the Boo-to-You Halloween parade, this spooky rider gallops down Main Street on his horse.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is the Headless Horseman! Hold on to your heads, folks.

clues.clue: The Halloween event called Oogie Boogie Bash takes place in this Disneyland Resort park.
clues.reveal: [laughs] The correct answer is Disney California Adventure! Oogie Boogie throws a great party. Just don't play dice with him.
